title: Orthographic 45-degree isometric view
description:
1、Based on image_5.png, the orthographic 45-degree isometric view of the Film Industrial Park is now densely populated with active production details. Sound Stages 1 & 2 have open bay doors revealing lit interiors with sets, crew members, forklifts, and large cable bundles outside. The central office area features luxury cars in the parking slots and people in business attire. The Western town set has a full film crew with cameras on cranes, actors in costume, and horses. The medieval castle set has extras in armor, prop weapon racks, and green screens. The sci-fi set has technicians working on glowing panels and futuristic vehicle props. Everywhere there are additional light stands, boom microphones, craft service tables, and directors' chairs, enhancing the busy, high-polish "Project Makeover" game art style.

2、 Orthographic 45-degree isometric view of the complete Film Industrial Park, strictly adhering to the exact pathway layout defined in 'Road line tamplate.jpg' (image_0.png). The golden paved road network with beveled edges follows the precise curves and forks of the reference map. At the bottom center entrance, the 'FILM CITY' gate is positioned. Along the left loop and top-left areas are large industrial Sound Stages ('STAGE 1', 'STAGE 2') and prop warehouses with loading docks. The central island loop contains a modern administrative office and a large fountain plaza. The right-side zones feature distinct backlot sets: a Western town street, a medieval stone castle, and a futuristic sci-fi facade. All assets are rendered in the high-detail, stylized realism of Project Makeover, with cinematic lighting, soft shadows, manicured trees, vintage film vehicles, and production equipment scattered throughout the grid landscape. No vanishing point.
